# OA Group (OAGroupNG)
> A diversified Nigerian business group providing integrated professional and commercial services through five CAC-registered subsidiary entities.

## Purpose
OAGroupNG (oagroupng.com) is the parent hub for OA Group — a multi-sector Nigerian business group operating across Accounting, Consulting, Real Estate, Financial Services, and Contracting.

## Primary Services
- Accounting & Audit (Olusola Adekanola & Co)
- Management Consulting (OA Consulting Limited)
- Real Estate & Property (Henrisol Properties Ltd)
- Financial Services & Microfinance (Maria Oyinlola Limited / MOL)
- Contracting & Procurement (Pearl Primus Multipurpose Contracting Limited)

## Target Audience
Nigerian businesses, individuals, government institutions, and corporate organisations seeking professional and commercial services.
